name: Lesson 1 Great inventions
definition: 学习谈论生活中伟大的发明，了解造纸术等历史发明。
key_points: 核心词汇：invention 发明、paper 纸、book 书、washing machine 洗衣机、phone 电话、plane 飞机、train 火车、travel 旅行、compass 指南针、bulb 灯泡、telephone 电话、printer 打印机、farther 更远、faster 更快、history 历史
核心句型：With it, we can ...（有了它，我们能……）/ There are many great inventions.（有许多伟大的发明。）/ How did people ... in the past?（过去人们怎么……？）/ People ... in the past.（过去人们……。）/ Is ... a great invention?（……是伟大的发明吗？）
语法点：一般过去时（How did people get in touch / travel in the past? People wrote letters. People travelled by horse.）；形容词比较级 farther and faster
common_mistakes: travel 的过去式 travelled 容易漏写一个 l
比较级 farther/faster 与最高级 furthest/fastest 混淆
invent 的过去式 invented 与 invention 名词形式混淆
publisher: 广东教育出版社（粤教沪外教版）
